model: Royal Engineers; 1st Lyran Royal Guards RCT

fluff.overview: The Royal Engineers maintain a separate reporting structure from regular Lyran infantry, making them difficult to locate within the LCAF's bureaucracy. Armed with Gunther MP-20 submachine guns and organized into small platoons of just two seven-trooper squads, they are not fielded as a direct combat force. Their value lies in what they build and what they destroy. Capable of engineering fieldwork and demolitions, the Royal Engineers serve as a force multiplier for any formation they attach to, integrating with regular infantry or combined-arms units as the mission demands. Most line officers would scoff if asked whether combat engineers concern them. Most generals would not.
